name: salt-mfs-floor
description: Married filing separately with MAGI $400,000 and SALT paid $30,000: the $20,000 MFS base cap is reduced by 30% of the $150,000 excess over the $250,000 MFS threshold, hitting the $5,000 MFS floor (the worksheet's line-10 halving of the $10,000 floor).

source.publication: Instructions for Schedule A (Form 1040) (2025), State and Local Taxes Worksheet lines 5-10; Instructions for Form 1040 (2025) 'What's New'
source.pin: 'The overall limit on the deduction for state and local income, sales, and property taxes has increased to $40,000 ($20,000 if married filing separately)... reduced if your modified adjusted gross income is more than $500,000 ($250,000 if married filing separately) but will not be reduced below $10,000 ($5,000 if married filing separately).'

derivation: Wages $400,000 = MAGI; SALT paid = 20,000 + 10,000 = $30,000; itemizing elected.

MFS cap: 20,000 - 30% x (400,000 - 250,000) = 20,000 - 45,000 = -25,000, floored at $5,000 (MFS floor = half of the worksheet's $10,000 line 9, per line 10's 'half the amount... if married filing separately').
